## Summary

| ID | Region | Defect | Evidence |
|----|--------|--------|----------|
| F1 | `nodehost.go` `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` | Enqueues a ReadIndex request without waking the execution engine; the request is only dispatched by the next tick. Up to one RTT added latency; a one-RTT timeout deterministically returns `RequestTimeout` on a healthy cluster, while `NodeHost.ReadIndex` with the same timeout completes. | Executed (5/5 failures), latency measurement, causality check in `audit/diag`. |
| F2 | `internal/raft/raft.go` `handleCandidateReadIndex` | The dropped ReadIndex is recorded twice, so `pb.Update.DroppedReadIndexes` contains the same `SystemCtx` twice for one request. Currently idempotent downstream; the raft update is wrong. | Executed at raft level and through exported `Peer.GetUpdate`. |
| F3 | `raftpb/raft.go` `(*Update).HasUpdate` | Ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`: `Peer.HasUpdate` reports an update for a node whose only pending work is a dropped read index, while `Update.HasUpdate()` returns false for the very same update. No production caller of `Update.HasUpdate` exists in this tree. | Executed (`TestAuditUpdateHasUpdateWithDroppedReadIndexes`). |

Quick verification of the findings (a few seconds):

```
go test -tags dragonboat_no_rocksdb,dragonboat_audit -run TestAudit -v ./internal/raft/
# FAIL TestAuditCandidateReadIndexIsDroppedOnce, FAIL TestAuditPeerUpdateDroppedReadIndexes,
# FAIL TestAuditUpdateHasUpdateWithDroppedReadIndexes
isolated_exec: go test -tags dragonboat_no_rocksdb,dragonboat_audit \
    -run TestAuditNodeUserReadIndexOneTickTimeout -v .
# FAIL: timeout on the INodeUser path; the NodeHost control in the same test passes
```

Overall assessment: three concrete defects were found, one user-visible (F1,
the `INodeUser` read path) and two local/API-level (F2, F3). Beyond those, the
consensus core held up under a randomised 3/5-node protocol fuzz with loss,
reordering and partitions, a randomised model check of the in-memory log, a
crash-restart vote-safety check, and a property test of the entry codec; the
full buildable test matrix (including the transport suite with TLS in a
diagnostic copy) and the race detector are green. The three minimal fixes
listed under "Fix verification" resolve every reproduction without breaking
the upstream suites.

## Unresolved work

  rocksdb-backed packages (`internal/logdb/tee`, `plugin`, `plugin/tee`,
  `internal/logdb/kv/rocksdb/gorocksdb`), which cannot build offline.

- All `INodeUser`-style public entry points were checked against the wakeup
  pattern; `nodeUser.ReadIndex` is the only one missing it, but a systematic
  mutant-based sweep of the root package was not performed.
- Whether F2 manifests anywhere outside `pb.Update` consumers (for example in

  investigated further, since the current node layer is unaffected.
- The randomised model check covers `inMemory` directly; the composition in

item.text:
This pass finished reading the last unreviewed code and closed out the report.

**What I did**

- Reviewed the remaining snapshot-integrity code: the v2 block validator (`v2validator.Validate`, `validateMagicSize`, block checksum walk) and `GetV2PayloadChecksum` / `getV2CRCOffsetListFromFileSize`. Hand-checked the CRC-offset arithmetic for full blocks, partial final blocks and exact-multiple payloads; it matches the writer's layout and the tail size/magic check. No defect.
- Saved the final matrix of the audited tree to `audit/cover/audit_matrix.log` and referenced it from the report.
- Added an **Overall assessment** paragraph to the report and corrected the unresolved-work list (the sibling callee-set comparison and F2's idempotence check are now recorded as done).

**Final state**

Three concrete findings, each reproduced on the unmodified source and each verified fixed by a minimal patch in `audit/diag-fixes/` with no regressions:

- F1 — `(*nodeUser).ReadIndex` in [nodehost.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/nodehost.go:2063) misses the engine wakeup: ~one RTT added latency; a one-RTT timeout deterministically fails (two-RTT succeeds), while `NodeHost.ReadIndex` completes.
- F2 — `handleCandidateReadIndex` in [raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/internal/raft/raft.go:1998) records a dropped ReadIndex twice; visible via `Peer.GetUpdate`, idempotent downstream.
- F3 — `pb.Update.HasUpdate` in [raftpb/raft.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/raftpb/raft.go:112) ignores `DroppedReadIndexes`, contradicting `Peer.HasUpdate`.

Everything else held up: randomised 3/5-node protocol fuzz with loss/reordering/partitions, in-memory log model check, crash-restart vote safety, colfer entry-encoding property test, follower/observer reads, leader transfer, 1–32 MB proposals (single and two nodes), the full transport suite including TLS in a diagnostic copy, and the race detector.

[report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_20-19-30-dragonboat_raft-baseline/work/report.md) is the complete handoff: summary with a quick-verification block, overall assessment, three findings with expected/actual/conditions/evidence, source-based observations, reviewed-areas catalogue, reproduction inventory, fix verification, command log and unresolved work. The audited tree remains byte-identical to `../source`.
